traits: Cap 6 to 20 cm, convex to depressed, mostly blood red, pink, crimson or purple, sometimes with a yellowish or orange centre
Gills crowded, cream then yellow, sometimes reddish at the edges
Stem 5 to 15 cm, white, sometimes tinged pink, slightly club-shaped
White flesh, mild taste, no smell, soon soft and greyish
Coniferous woods and peat bogs, especially under pines; locally very common
safetyNote: Edible: the DGfM and the VAPKO list it, and Wikipedia (en) says it is a common sight in Finnish markets. Wikipedia (en) warns that it can easily be mistaken for the sickener, which is poisonous: see the group. It has no French Wikipedia page and no English common name: the text comes from Wikipedia (en) and the DGfM.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
VAPKO, Vereinigung amtlicher Pilzkontrollorgane der Schweiz (2023). Empfehlungsliste (liste des champignons recommandés), version 09.2023.
